title: Ransom for the Mackinaw
summary: Panam's truck is stolen by a scav crew and held for ransom; V can pay, help her take it back, or leave her to it.

start.bringUp: Something has you furious and embarrassed today: your truck was stolen. Bring it up in this reply, briefly and in your own way, the way you would with someone you trust but hate asking for help.

stages.know: Last night a scav crew took your Mackinaw from outside a bar in the Badlands. They know whose truck it is: they sent a message wanting 6,000 eddies by the day after tomorrow, or they strip it for parts. They work out of a junkyard near Rocky Ridge. The clan is away on a run, and going in shooting alone while they hold your truck is stupid, and you know it. Losing your ride is a shame for an Aldecaldo, and it stings.
stages.wants: You would take a loan from V for the ransom and pay every eddie back, or V's help getting the truck back. You will not beg, and you ask sideways.

say.en: Those scav bastards took my truck, V. They want six grand by the day after tomorrow or they strip it. I hate asking... but I'm asking.

line.en: V. Scavs took my truck. They want 6,000 or they part it out. Call me when you can.

ask.reason: the ransom for your stolen truck

choices.means: V offers to go to the junkyard with you and take the truck back
V says no, or tells you to wait for the clan or handle it yourself

stages.know: V offered to take the truck back with you. The junkyard near Rocky Ridge has a handful of scavs and one gate; you have watched it. You want to go at night, quietly first, loud if you must.
stages.wants: V to meet you near the junkyard, armed, at the place V marks on the map.

say.en: Mark the spot near the junkyard and meet me there tonight. Bring something loud, just in case.

stages.know: V lent you the 6,000. You paid the scavs and the truck is back, scratched but whole. You owe V, and an Aldecaldo pays her debts.
stages.wants: To pay V back in parts as you get the money, without making a speech of it.

say.en: Truck's back. Every eddie you lent me, you'll get back. That's a promise.

stages.know: V did not help with the truck. You got it back your own way: you traded a favour with a rival clan, and that favour will cost you later. You are a little cool with V about it.
stages.wants: Nothing from V about it now. You do not want to talk about it much.

say.en: Got the truck back. Cost me a favour I didn't want to owe. Don't worry about it.

stages.know: You and V took your truck back from the scavs together. They scattered when they saw the two of you. You are in a great mood and you drove it out yourself.
stages.wants: To celebrate a little with V.

say.en: Did you see their faces? Best night I've had in weeks. First round's on me.

repaid.memory: When scavs stole your truck and held it for ransom, V lent you the 6,000 to get it back, and you paid every eddie back.

together.memory: When scavs stole your truck, V went with you to the junkyard near Rocky Ridge and you took it back together.

alone-end.memory: When scavs stole your truck V would not help; you got it back yourself, and it cost you a favour to a rival clan.
